consequence: a registration becomes stale by elapsed time since its last update check (86400 s), so the browser re-fetches the seed script whenever reachable
excerpt: A [=/service worker registration=] is said to be <dfn>stale</dfn> if the registration's [=last update check time=] is non-null and the time difference in seconds calculated by the current time minus the registration's [=last update check time=] is greater than 86400.
